paper.core_task: unsupervised categorical pose estimation from images

contributions.name: A method for unsupervised learning of categorical pose priors
contributions.author_claim_text: We propose a new method called the Pose Prior Learner (PPL). PPL is designed to effectively learn a meaningful pose prior for a certain object category.
contributions.description: Introduces PPL, a method that learns a general pose prior for an object category without human annotations. It uses a hierarchical memory to store prototypical poses and distills them into keypoint and connectivity priors.

contributions.name: An iterative inference strategy for occluded pose estimation
contributions.author_claim_text: During inference, we utilize an iterative strategy in which PPL progressively leverages priors to refine estimated poses by regressing them to the nearest prototypical poses stored in memory.
contributions.description: Proposes an iterative refinement procedure during inference that uses the learned prior and hierarchical memory to reconstruct occluded image parts and predict complete poses.

novelty_claims.text: The proposed method introduces a new approach to unsupervised learning of pose priors, utilizing a hierarchical memory structure.
The iterative inference strategy is a unique contribution, enhancing the model's ability to estimate poses in occluded scenes.
